identity_selection: first count entries of the existing ordered manifest; identical across cases
native_recipe: Original JPEG bytes copied exactly; no decode/reencode, EXIF rotation or geometry change; RGB and grayscale inputs decoded to RGB
resized_recipe: Original source; EXIF transpose; RGB without ICC; bilinear short side=max(target width,height); Python round; floor center crop; reducing_gap=None
encoder: Resized cases: Pillow JPEG Q50/Q90, subsampling=2, progressive=False, optimize=False
validation: Every file: JPEG metadata and full RGB simplejpeg decode. Public-route pixel equality is checked by run.py before its timer.
scope_note: Extract of the existing manifest; only native-original is used by this worktree.
